response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience, which is a severe mismatch for an entry-level Junior Java Developer role. He would be significantly overqualified, his core expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js/DLang rather than Java, and his German is listed as only 'Basic' against a role requiring strong verbal and written communication in German.
strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across many domains (web, mobile, embedded, backend)
Strong familiarity with agile/craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated experience with cloud/kubernetes and architecture design
concerns: Massive seniority mismatch - Staff/Senior level applying for an entry-level junior position
Java is only a minor listed skill, not a primary language in his recent work history
German proficiency listed as only 'Basic', falling short of required strong communication skills
